requests.text: My calendar is wall-to-wall client calls and I have no time to think between meetings.
Every month I reconcile supplier invoices from SAP against the contract terms in SharePoint by hand. It takes me about two days.
After every customer call I spend 20 minutes writing notes into Salesforce.
Who can help me give a new analytics team access to Databricks tables without breaking Unity Catalog permissions?
Is there a way to summarise Jira feedback every week?
We drown in feature requests in Jira and need a digest.
How can I clean duplicate customer records safely?
Back-to-back meetings all day, how can I get real breaks without moving everything?
Можно ли автоматически находить окна в календаре для коротких перерывов между встречами?
I'm in workshops all week and burning out, can something protect my recovery time?
My calendar is full of meetings and I never get time to think. Any help?
Too many calls back to back, I need small gaps between meetings.
Need to log meeting outcomes in Salesforce faster after demos.
Как быстро превратить запись звонка в заметки для CRM?
Can we automatically summarise customer feedback tickets every Monday?
Extract payment terms and penalties from supplier contract PDFs into a table.
Vendor line items in the SAP export have broken dates and currencies before upload.
How do I request Unity Catalog access for a new teammate?
Who can review my Power BI semantic model before it goes to the CFO?
Who knows ServiceNow workflows well enough to sanity check mine?
Turn our weekly team meeting notes into a Confluence page with action items.
Write up action items automatically after every project sync.
I need meeting minutes drafted from the Teams transcript.
Как быстро оформить meeting notes и action items после встречи?
Create an onboarding plan for a new analyst joining next month.
Onboarding checklist of access and tools for a new joiner in my team.
Нужен onboarding plan для нового сотрудника, с чего начать?
Answer customer security questionnaires from our previous responses.
Reuse earlier RFP answers when a client sends a new questionnaire.
Approve travel expense reports faster, they pile up at month end.
Remind managers about missing expense receipts every month.
Compare vendor proposals against our evaluation criteria.
